properties.evidence: Two halves of one arrangement, recorded as SUPPORTING so it reinforces rather than conflicts (req:supporting-is-not-conflict). The third-party rule says a fix is judged by what it does for somebody else's project; this says the self-host is what GENERATES the finding, because reflow2's own design is the first place a missing detector shows up as pain. Neither replaces the other, and this one explicitly does not weaken the third-party rule's named failure: patch it here, mark it met, leave every consumer with the hole.
